summary: Validated the frontend-only Framewright landing, login, generator modes, mocked 13-stage completion, inspector, output editor/source copy, preview variation, and mobile layout.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger button is visible and clickable on mobile but has no onClick behavior and does not open navigation; Home/Studio/Preview remain inaccessible if the desktop nav is hidden in a narrower layout.

action_items: Implement the mobile menu toggle/drawer or remove the hamburger control; ensure route links remain accessible on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Generation and job history are intentionally MOCKED; no backend/API integration was expected or tested.
The visible mobile-menu-button has no state or handler, making it a dead interactive control on mobile.
seed_data_creation: None; mock job history is static and login session used qa@example.com only in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing, login, all input modes, file input presence, generation completion, inspector, output editor/source, preview A/B, and mobile overflow were exercised. Recheck mobile hamburger after fix.
rca of the issue: Nav renders mobile-menu-button unconditionally on mobile via CSS, but Nav defines no menu state and the button has no onClick handler. The desktop nav is still displayed in the tested 390px viewport, masking route accessibility rather than providing a functional mobile menu. An initial combined test also timed out waiting for navigation immediately after submit, but a second run with explicit field waits passed; this was test timing, not a reproduced product failure.
